# Vendored library

TinyXML2 **11.0.0** is statically compiled for parsing GPIF XML from Guitar Pro ZIP files.

- Upstream: https://github.com/leethomason/tinyxml2
- Pinned tag: https://github.com/leethomason/tinyxml2/tree/11.0.0
- Files: `tinyxml2/tinyxml2.cpp`, `tinyxml2/tinyxml2.h`
- License: zlib, preserved in `tinyxml2/LICENSE.txt` and the source headers.
- Local modifications: none.

Normal builds use these checked-in source files and do not download packages.
